name: ado
description: Recipes, skills, trigger types, and hostable tools for working with Azure DevOps pull requests, comments, and iterations. Bundles three trigger types: a cold 'new PR watcher', a hot 'comment watcher', and a mixed-mode 'PR pulse watcher'.

trigger_types.description: Detect new PRs in a repo; start a pr-review thread for each via callback. Cold trigger -- ticks on the default cron schedule whether or not any pr-review threads are live. Self-state tracks lastCheckedAt per registration.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: ADO repo name to watch for new PRs.

parameters.name: assigned_to
parameters.description: Filter to PRs assigned to this user (uniqueName).

parameters.name: opened_by
parameters.description: Filter to PRs opened by this user; useful to exclude self-authored PRs.

trigger_types.description: Wake an existing thread on new PR comments. Hot trigger -- registered per-thread by the pr-review recipe; auto-unregistered when the subscriber thread terminates.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: ADO repo name containing the PR.

parameters.name: pr_id
parameters.description: PR id to watch comments on.

parameters.name: self_user
parameters.description: Filter out comments authored by this user to avoid reply loops.

trigger_types.description: Mixed Mode A+B watcher -- burst of live events (comments + iterations) for a configurable budget, then a final summary on exit. No default cron -- typically one-shot/manual.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: ADO repo name containing the PR.

parameters.name: max_run_sec
parameters.description: Total seconds this invocation is allowed to run.

parameters.name: poll_interval_sec
parameters.description: Seconds between polls inside the loop.

parameters.name: self_user
parameters.description: Skip events authored by this user.
